jobs.title: Product Lead, BillPay Mexico (SPEI)
jobs.description:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

ABOUT CLARA Clara is the leading spend management platform for businesses in Latin America. We provide corporate cards, expense management, and AP automation across Mexico, Colombia, and Brazil. Our mission: give every company in Latin America complete control of their spending.

Small, high-powered squads. Senior engineers. AI tools baked into how we work. The person running product for a squad doesn't just write specs — they own outcomes end to end.

ABOUT THE ROLE SPEI is Mexico's primary interbank payment rail. For Clara customers, it powers everything from supplier payments to tax disbursements to payroll runs. BillPay Mexico is the product that makes this seamless — domestic and cross-border transfers, payment tracking, reconciliation, and the compliance layer that keeps everything clean with SAT, CNBV, and banking partners.

This is a squad lead role reporting directly to the Global Product Director. You'll own the full BillPay product experience for the Mexican market: payment flows, bank partner integrations, disbursement reliability, and the back-office tooling that supports operations and finance. You'll work closely with engineers, design, banking infrastructure, compliance, and enterprise sales teams.

This role requires physical presence in Mexico City — we're in active conversations with banking partners and regulators, and showing up in person matters.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own discovery, prioritization, and outcomes for the BillPay MX squad — understand why payment success rates move, why reconciliation breaks, and why customers churn, not just what launched

- Build deep understanding of SPEI infrastructure: clearing windows, return codes, CLABE validation, and failure propagation — and extend that to cross-border flows (FX rails, correspondent banking, settlement timing)

- Maintain and evolve banking partner relationships from a product perspective: know what integration contracts allow, where bottlenecks are, and what needs to be negotiated next

- Own compliance signals: SAT requirements, CNBV guidelines, and PLD/AML obligations for transfer products

- Define and track the metrics that matter: payment success rate, settlement time, reconciliation error rate, time-to-resolve for failed transfers, and BillPay contribution to customer retention

- Design and iterate on disbursement workflows — from single transfers to bulk payment runs for hundreds of suppliers

- Prototype with AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, v0) before committing engineering time

- Contribute straightforward code changes (copy, config, feature flags, simple UI, analytics) through engineer-reviewed PRs

- Work in Git daily: read PRs, understand what shipped, follow what's blocked

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Experience

- 5+ years in product management, with at least 2 years owning a payments, banking, or financial infrastructure product

- Track record of shipping products that moved business metrics — not just features that launched

- Hands-on experience with payment rails, banking APIs, or financial infrastructure at a product level

- Comfortable working with engineers as peers, not through project managers or coordinators

Domain knowledge — payments

- Deep understanding of SPEI: clearing cycles, error handling, CLABE structure, and how to design reliable retry and fallback flows

- Familiarity with cross-border payment rails: FX conversion, correspondent banking, SWIFT or alternative rails, and associated compliance overhead

- Familiarity with Mexican banking regulations: SAT CFDIs, CNBV licensing implications, AML/PLD obligations

- Experience integrating with or managing bank correspondent relationships from a product side

- Understands how reconciliation works end to end: what breaks it, how to design around it, and how to give finance teams the visibility they need

Technical fluency

- Can prototype a working concept using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar)

- Comfortable with Git: branches, commits, PRs, reading diffs

- Can read code well enough to follow what a PR does and ask informed questions

- Understands API integrations, webhooks, async payment flows, and idempotency patterns at a conceptual level

Product fundamentals

- Strong discovery instincts — finds the real problem before designing a solution

- Data-literate: comfortable with SQL, funnel analysis, and experiment design

- Clear written communicator in both Spanish and English

- Strong stakeholder management across engineering, banking partners, compliance, finance, and enterprise sales

Mindset

- High agency — defaults to action over process

- Treats AI tools as core workflow, not a novelty

- Comfortable in ambiguous regulatory environments — knows how to make progress without waiting for perfect clarity

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with ERP integrations (SAP, Oracle, Aspel, CONTPAQi) from a payments or AP perspective

- Familiarity with Banxico's regulatory framework and SPEI operating rules

- Experience with multi-currency or cross-border payment products at production scale

- SQL fluency beyond "can write a query" — you've built your own dashboards and done your own reconciliation analysis

LANGUAGES Full bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish required. Native or near-native Spanish is a hard requirement — not a nice-to-have. You'll work in English with cross-functional teams across LatAm and in Spanish with banking partners, regulators, and customers in Mexico. Portuguese is a plus.

Where we work

This is a hybrid role: you'll split your time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles — you'll spend time in the office naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.
Why Clara

- A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

- Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

- An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

- English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

- Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

- Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

- Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

- Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

- ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

- Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

jobs.title: Product Lead (Líder de Producto) - LATAM
jobs.description:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

Who We Are

We build in small, autonomous squads. We default to action over process. We treat AI as core workflow, not a novelty. We care more about what you've shipped than where you studied. If you're the kind of person who prototypes before they present, ships before they ask permission, and earns trust by being close to the work, you'll fit here.

What is a Product Lead?

A Product Lead owns the product direction for a small, autonomous squad. You decide what to build, why it matters, and whether it worked. You're accountable for business outcomes, not just features shipped.

What makes this role different from a traditional Product Manager? You don't write specs and hand them off. You prototype ideas with AI tools before committing engineering time. You contribute code for straightforward changes (copy, config, feature flags, simple UI updates) so you can unblock yourself and move faster. You work in Git daily, read PRs, and understand what shipped without needing a status meeting.

The core job is still product judgment, discovery, and stakeholder alignment. But the technical bar is higher than a traditional PM role. You need to hold your own in architectural conversations, earn engineering's trust by being close to the work, and use AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow.

This isn't a PM who codes full-time. And it isn't an engineering lead with product responsibilities bolted on. It's what we believe the best product person looks like in the AI era: someone who can own outcomes and move fast without waiting for handoffs.

What We Expect

Experience

- 5+ years in product management, product engineering, product design, or a hybrid building role

- Track record of shipping products that moved business metrics, not just features that launched

- Experience working directly with engineers as peers

- You've built something in production yourself

Technical Fluency

- You can prototype a working concept using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar)

- Comfortable with Git: cloning repos, creating branches, pushing commits, reading diffs

- You can read code well enough to follow what a PR does and ask good questions about it

- You understand system architecture at the level of "how do these services talk to each other" and "where does the data live"

Product Fundamentals

- Strong discovery skills: you know how to identify the right problem before solving it

- Data literate: comfortable with SQL, dashboards, and experiment design

- Clear written communicator: you can write a one-pager that drives alignment without a meeting

- Stakeholder management across engineering, design, sales, and leadership

Mindset

- High agency. You default to action over process.

- AI tools are core workflow for you, not a novelty

- Comfortable being the only non-engineer in the room and earning that room's trust

Nice to Have

- CS, engineering, or technical degree

- Can produce near-production-ready code for straightforward changes using AI tools, suitable for engineer review and merge

- Experience building AI-powered products

- Experience in fintech, enterprise, or domains requiring complex systems thinking

- Experience in high-growth startups

Where we work

This is a hybrid role: you'll split your time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles — you'll spend time in the office naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.
Why Clara

- A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

- Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

- An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

- English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

- Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

- Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

- Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

- Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

- ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

- Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

Quem Somos Construímos em squads pequenos e autônomos. Priorizamos ação em vez de processo. Tratamos a IA como parte central do nosso fluxo de trabalho, não como uma novidade. Nos importamos mais com o que você entregou do que com onde você estudou. Se você é o tipo de pessoa que prototipa antes de apresentar, lança antes de pedir permissão e conquista confiança por estar perto do trabalho, você vai se encaixar aqui.

O que é um Product Lead? Um Product Lead é responsável pela direção de produto de um squad pequeno e autônomo. Você decide o que construir, por que isso importa e se funcionou. Você é responsável pelos resultados de negócio, não apenas pelas funcionalidades entregues.

O que diferencia esse papel de um Product Manager tradicional? Você não escreve especificações e as passa adiante. Esse não é um PM que programa em tempo integral. Tampouco é um líder de engenharia com responsabilidades de produto adicionadas. É o que acreditamos ser o melhor perfil de produto na era da IA: alguém que pode ser dono dos resultados e se mover rapidamente sem esperar por handoffs.

- Fortes habilidades de descoberta: você sabe identificar o problema certo antes de resolvê-lo

jobs.description:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

Who We Are

We build in small, autonomous squads. We default to action over process. We treat AI as core workflow, not a novelty. We care more about what you've shipped than where you studied. If you're the kind of person who prototypes before they present, ships before they ask permission, and earns trust by being close to the work, you'll fit here.

What is a Product Lead?

A Product Lead owns the product direction for a small, autonomous squad. You decide what to build, why it matters, and whether it worked. You're accountable for business outcomes, not just features shipped.

What makes this role different from a traditional Product Manager? You don't write specs and hand them off. You prototype ideas with AI tools before committing engineering time. You contribute code for straightforward changes (copy, config, feature flags, simple UI updates) so you can unblock yourself and move faster. You work in Git daily, read PRs, and understand what shipped without needing a status meeting.

The core job is still product judgment, discovery, and stakeholder alignment. But the technical bar is higher than a traditional PM role. You need to hold your own in architectural conversations, earn engineering's trust by being close to the work, and use AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow.

This isn't a PM who codes full-time. And it isn't an engineering lead with product responsibilities bolted on. It's what we believe the best product person looks like in the AI era: someone who can own outcomes and move fast without waiting for handoffs.

What We Expect

Experience

- 5+ years in product management, product engineering, product design, or a hybrid building role

- Track record of shipping products that moved business metrics, not just features that launched

- Experience working directly with engineers as peers

- You've built something in production yourself

Technical Fluency

- You can prototype a working concept using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar)

- Comfortable with Git: cloning repos, creating branches, pushing commits, reading diffs

- You can read code well enough to follow what a PR does and ask good questions about it

- You understand system architecture at the level of "how do these services talk to each other" and "where does the data live"

Product Fundamentals

- Strong discovery skills: you know how to identify the right problem before solving it

- Data literate: comfortable with SQL, dashboards, and experiment design

- Clear written communicator: you can write a one-pager that drives alignment without a meeting

- Stakeholder management across engineering, design, sales, and leadership

Mindset

- High agency. You default to action over process.

- AI tools are core workflow for you, not a novelty

- Comfortable being the only non-engineer in the room and earning that room's trust

Nice to Have

- CS, engineering, or technical degree

- Can produce near-production-ready code for straightforward changes using AI tools, suitable for engineer review and merge

- Experience building AI-powered products

- Experience in fintech, enterprise, or domains requiring complex systems thinking

- Experience in high-growth startups

Where we work

This is a hybrid role: you'll split your time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles — you'll spend time in the office naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.
Why Clara

- A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

- Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

- An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

- English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

- Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

- Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

- Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

- Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

- ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

- Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

jobs.title: Product Lead - Risk
jobs.description:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

We're looking for a Product Lead, Risk to lead our new Risk Builder squad within the Biz Ops tribe. Risk is one of the highest-leverage areas in Clara’s product portfolio; getting credit lines, identity verification, and fraud signals right is what allows us to scale rapidly across LatAm without increasing losses.

As the Product Lead for this lean, high-ownership squad, you will report to the Group Product Manager and partner directly with a senior engineer, Credit Risk, Fraud, Finance, and Data Science teams. You will own the full credit lifecycle from a product perspective—balancing high-velocity execution with strict risk mitigation.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

-
Owning the entire Risk product surface across both Acquisition and Portfolio Management, including onboarding risk checks, credit line increases/decreases, and internal tools for the Fraud Risk Operations team.

-
Managing the integration layer with critical Credit and Fraud Risk vendors (Decisioning Engines, Credit Bureaus, SIFT, and ID Validation Vendors), mapping gaps, and making high-impact build vs. buy decisions.

-
Translating complex risk model outputs into seamless product experiences by collaborating closely with Data Science and Credit Risk teams to design around model uncertainty.

-
Defining and tracking core business metrics , including approval rates, fraud loss rates, credit utilization, credit line adjustment accuracy, and time-to-decision.

-
Accelerating product delivery by writing clear PRDs, managing the product backlog, and driving cross-team alignment without relying on unnecessary meetings.

-
Building no-code/low-code solutions and automating workflows using tools like N8N or Oscilar.

-
Embracing a builder mindset by leveraging AI tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or v0 to prototype concepts, making straightforward code or configuration changes, and self-serving your own analytics dashboards.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

-
Experience: 5+ years of experience in product management, with at least 2 years explicitly focused on risk, fraud, credit, identity, or lending-adjacent products within fintech or payment platforms.

-
Technical Fluency: Ability to prototype concepts using AI coding tools, familiarity with GitHub (managing branches, commits, PRs, and reading diffs), and a solid conceptual understanding of API integrations and webhook-based event flows.

-
Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of credit-line mechanics (segmentation, adjustments), KYC/ID verification vendor stacks, and fraud signals (transaction blocking, step-up authentication).

-
Data & Analytics Literacy: Strong analytical skills with the ability to write SQL queries, conduct cohort analysis, design experiments, and build independent dashboards.

-
Execution & Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English; a track record of moving hard business metrics (loss rates, approval rates) and managing cross-functional stakeholders across Legal, Finance, and Data Science.

-
Mindset: High agency, comfort with ambiguity, and an eagerness to operate in a lean, fast-paced squad with massive autonomy.

Nice to haves

-
Working proficiency or basic knowledge of Spanish or Portuguese, with a desire to learn.

-
Product experience within LatAm fintech markets, specifically dealing with credit products in Mexico, Colombia, or Brazil.

-
Familiarity with specialized decisioning platforms (e.g., Oscilar) and local direct debit or payment rails ( SPEI , Pix , ACH ) and their inherent risk implications.

Where we work

This is a remote-first role: you'll work from home day to day. You'll ramp up in person with the team, and come together in person for team moments, events and customer visits through the year.
Why Clara

- A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

- Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

- An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

- English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

- Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

- Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

- Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

- Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

- ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

- Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.
